resources.string: Point the top of your phone toward the fan.

An independent, open-source community remote. Not affiliated with Atomberg.

Based on Atomberg-BLDC-IR-Remote by Mobashshir Ahsan (Mobasheera), under the MIT License.
github.com/Mobasheera/Atomberg-BLDC-IR-Remote

This version adds a compact native interface, IR compatibility checks, and a corrected LED signal. Tested on Renesa 1200 mm with Realme GT 7T.

Protocol research: Glen Zac. Published LED capture: Pramod Ghuge. The LED change corrects MSB/LSB conversion; it is not a claim to discovering the protocol.

No accounts, advertisements, or network permission.
The MIT license is included in the source repository as LICENSE.
